title: Weapon UP!
description: Adds weapons to dungeons and their leveling!
body:
# Own
A mod for Minecraft 1.20.1 that adds a weapon leveling system. Swords gain experience by killing mobs, and axes gain experience by chopping trees. Leveling up unlocks unique upgrades: lifesteal, critical hits, seismic impact, whirlwind, and much more. Upgrade your weapons to level 30.


# ⚔ Two Progression Paths                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
  Warrior — for mod swords. Kill mobs to gain XP (+10 per kill, more with upgrades). Reach level 30 to become Invincible.                                                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
  Lumberjack — for mod axes. Chop logs to gain XP (+1 per log, more with upgrades). Reach level 30 to become the Grove Keeper.                                                                                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
  Both paths have 30 levels and 6 named milestones (every 5 levels). At each milestone a custom upgrade-selection screen opens — pick one of three random upgrades from the pool. 
#⚡ Abilities
  
  Abilities unlock at level 20 when you pick the relevant upgrade at a milestone. Activate your weapon's ability with the dedicated keybind (default: unbound, set it in Controls → Weapon Upgrade).
  
  All abilities come with particle effects and on-screen cooldown feedback.
